verdict.rationale: A public company-register service could plausibly publish an API with an OpenAPI spec, so this story applies. The evidence shows only web search screens, a non-binding offer of structured data downloads, and a 404 for llms.txt. Nothing documents an API or a downloadable machine-readable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
